name: Modal

props.name: alert
props.description: Specify whether the Modal is displaying an alert, error or warning Should go hand in hand with the danger prop.

props.name: closeButtonLabel
props.description: Specify label for the close button of the modal; defaults to close

props.name: danger
props.description: Specify whether the Modal is for dangerous actions

props.name: dangerDescription
props.description: Specify the message read by screen readers for the danger primary button. Defaults to an empty string; provide localized text to opt in.

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a decorator component to be rendered inside the `Modal` component

props.name: hasScrollingContent
props.description: Specify whether the modal contains scrolling content

props.name: isFullWidth
props.description: Specify whether or not the Modal content should have any inner padding.

props.name: launcherButtonRef
props.description: Provide a ref to return focus to once the modal is closed.

props.name: loadingDescription
props.description: Specify the description for the loading text

props.name: loadingIconDescription
props.description: Specify the description for the loading text

props.name: loadingStatus
props.description: Specify loading status

props.name: modalAriaLabel
props.description: Specify a label to be read by screen readers on the modal root node

props.name: modalHeading
props.description: Specify the content of the modal header title.

props.name: modalLabel
props.description: Specify the content of the modal header label.

props.name: open
props.description: Specify whether the Modal is currently open

props.name: passiveModal
props.description: Specify whether the modal should be button-less

props.name: preventCloseOnClickOutside
props.description: Prevent closing on click outside of modal

props.name: primaryButtonDisabled
props.description: Specify whether the Button should be disabled, or not

props.name: primaryButtonText
props.description: Specify the text for the primary button

props.name: secondaryButtonText
props.description: Specify the text for the secondary button

props.name: secondaryButtons
props.description: Specify an array of config objects for secondary buttons

props.name: selectorPrimaryFocus
props.description: Specify a CSS selector that matches the DOM element that should be focused when the Modal opens

props.name: selectorsFloatingMenus
props.description: Specify CSS selectors that match DOM elements working as floating menus. Focusing on those elements won't trigger "focus-wrap" behavior

props.name: shouldSubmitOnEnter
props.description: Specify if Enter key should be used as "submit" action

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size variant.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `Modal` component

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Modal rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
